title: Bundle jsPDF + autoTable and remove CDN dependency for reliable PDF export

requirements.summary: Bundle and load jsPDF + autoTable via app imports (not window.jspdf/CDN) so Quote Summary and Analysis PDF exports work reliably with clear fallback errors.
acceptanceCriteria: From the Quote Summary screen, clicking "Export PDF" downloads a PDF without throwing the error "PDF export library is not loaded".
From the Analysis tab, clicking "Export PDF" downloads a PDF without throwing the error "PDF export library is not loaded".

The PDF export implementation does not rely on window.jspdf being pre-populated by CDN scripts; it uses app-bundled imports/loading so it works in production environments where external CDNs may be blocked.
If PDF libraries still fail to load for any reason, the user sees a clear English error message indicating PDF export could not be initialized and to try again.

file_operations.description: Add app-bundled dependencies for PDF generation (jsPDF and the autoTable plugin) so the app can import them at runtime instead of relying on global CDN scripts.

Refactor PDF export to use bundled imports/loading (jsPDF + autoTable) rather than window.jspdf; ensure the autoTable integration is initialized consistently and throw a clear English initialization error if libraries cannot be loaded.

Update the Quote Summary "Export PDF" handler to use the updated PDF exporter API (e.g., await if it becomes async) and surface a clear, user-friendly error message via the existing toast flow when PDF initialization/generation fails.

Update the Analysis tab "PDF" export handler to use the updated PDF exporter API (e.g., await if it becomes async) and ensure any PDF initialization/generation failure results in a clear English toast message instructing the user to try again.

requirements.summary: Ensure there is a single source of truth for PDF library loading by removing conflicting CDN/global loading and relying only on bundled imports to avoid jsPDF/autoTable mismatches.
acceptanceCriteria: The app does not end up in a state where jsPDF is present but autoTable is missing (or vice versa) due to conflicting load paths.
No console error appears during normal page load related to jsPDF or autoTable initialization.
Existing export flows continue to work with the same user-facing button labels (e.g., "Export PDF").

file_operations.description: Remove jsPDF and jsPDF-autoTable CDN script tags so PDF exporting is not double-loaded; keep the HTML entry focused on bootstrapping the app and any unrelated libraries still required.

Eliminate any remaining reliance on global/window-based PDF objects and ensure the exporter consistently initializes both jsPDF and autoTable from the same bundled load path to prevent runtime plugin-missing mismatches.
